0022600091.text: Both the Houston Rockets and the Dallas Mavericks open their 2026-27 seasons when they meet at Toyota Center in Houston. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting on January 31, 2026, went to the Rockets, 111-107. Dallas's injury list includes Dereck Lively II (foot, after surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions.
